candidates.lead: A tax return calculator estimates the refund or bill on the 2025-26 return by comparing the tax withheld from pay with the tax owed on the year's income, assessed on the 2025-26 rates (a 16% second bracket [[TAX_BRACKETS_2025_26]] and a 2% Medicare levy). The self-lodged return is due 31 October 2026 [[RETURN_2026.selfLodgeDueDate]] and most online refunds issue within 2 weeks [[RETURN_2026.onlineRefundTypical]].

An estimated tax return is the difference between the PAYG tax withheld from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 and the tax owed on the 2025-26 scale: $18,200 tax-free, then 16% to $45,000 and 30% to $135,000 [[TAX_BRACKETS_2025_26]], plus the 2% Medicare levy. More withheld than owed is a refund; less is a bill. The return is due 31 October 2026 if self-lodged, or 15 May 2027 through most tax agents [[RETURN_2026]].

A tax refund estimate for 2026 covers the 2025-26 income year: tax withheld minus tax assessed on taxable income after deductions, using the 2025-26 brackets [[TAX_BRACKETS_2025_26]] and the $700 Low Income Tax Offset [[LITO.maxOffset]]. Online returns are typically processed within 12 business days [[RETURN_2026]]; the self-lodgement deadline is 31 October 2026 [[RETURN_2026.selfLodgeDueDate]].
